name: Little EA
summary: A trend-following Expert Advisor that uses moving average crossover signals to identify and trade market trends. It enters long positions when fast MA crosses above slow MA and short positions on the reverse crossover, with built-in stop loss and take profit management. The EA operates systematically on each new bar to avoid excessive trading.
summary_zh: 这是一个趋势跟踪型EA，利用移动平均线交叉信号来识别和交易市场趋势。当快速均线向上穿越慢速均线时做多，反向交叉时做空，内置止损和止盈管理。EA在每个新K线上系统化运行以避免过度交易。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双移动平均线交叉系统，属于经典趋势跟踪方法。入场条件为快速均线穿越慢速均线时开仓，金叉做多死叉做空。出场条件包括止损和止盈的设置，以及均线反向交叉时的平仓信号。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未涉及动态仓位调整。资金管理方面依赖止损止盈比例控制单笔风险，但缺少总体资金管理框架。整体策略逻辑简单直接，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a dual moving average crossover system, which is a classic trend-following approach. Entry conditions trigger long positions when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA (golden cross) and short positions on the reverse (death cross). Exit conditions include predefined stop loss and take profit levels, as well as position closing on opposing crossover signals. Position sizing uses fixed lots without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management relies on stop loss and take profit ratios to control per-trade risk, but lacks an overall portfolio-level risk management framework. The strategy logic is straightforward and effective in trending markets but may generate frequent false signals in ranging or choppy conditions leading to consecutive losses.
pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和验证
使用经典趋势跟踪方法，在趋势市场中表现可靠
内置止损止盈，提供基本的风险控制
代码结构简洁，便于修改和扩展
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic that is easy to understand and verify
Uses a classic trend-following method that performs reliably in trending markets
Built-in stop loss and take profit provide basic risk control
Clean code structure that is easy to modify and extend
cons: 固定手数缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据市场波动调整
在震荡市中容易产生频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺少趋势过滤器，无法区分趋势和震荡市场
没有资金管理模块，无法控制总体风险敞口
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management and cannot adjust to market volatility
Prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging or choppy markets
No trend filter to distinguish between trending and ranging market conditions
Lacks a money management module to control overall risk exposure
improvements: 增加ADX或波动率过滤器来区分趋势和震荡市场
引入动态仓位管理，根据ATR或账户余额调整手数
添加移动止损功能以锁定浮动利润
improvements_en: Add ADX or volatility filter to distinguish between trending and ranging markets
Implement dynamic position sizing based on ATR or account equity
Add trailing stop functionality to lock in floating profits

risk_points: 固定手数无法根据账户风险动态调整
缺少震荡市场过滤可能导致连续止损
没有最大回撤控制或每日亏损限制
risk_points_en: Fixed lot size cannot dynamically adjust based on account risk
Lack of range market filter may lead to consecutive stop losses
No maximum drawdown control or daily loss limit
